architecture: v3 (a Florida nonprofit health system's 2027 heart failure early-diagnosis programme among five hospitals, by each hospital's two-year survival from diagnosis for its 2022 and 2023 newly diagnosed patients, the patients the registry lost when they moved beyond its death linkage counted at the survival their heart failure class at the move implies)
niche: a hospital system's heart failure registry whose death linkage reaches Florida certificates and a neighbouring-state records exchange only, in a retirement coast whose patients move back north to their families once their heart failure worsens, so their deaths never reach the registry
answer: Gullhaven Hospital: two-year survival 65%, 2 points below Fennick General Hospital's 67%
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every field and the committee's criterion correctly runs a Kaplan-Meier estimate for each hospital, ending each patient's follow-up at the move out of the death linkage's reach that the registry records, and names the urban hospital lowest; Kaplan-Meier credits the patients who moved north with the survival of those who stayed, but at the retirement-coast hospital they were mostly in NYHA class III or IV at their last visit, and carried at the survival their class implies its two-year survival is the lowest of the five.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each hospital's two-year survival from heart failure diagnosis, a time-to-event estimate whose loss to follow-up is driven by the patient's recorded NYHA class (frail retirees moving back to family beyond the registry's death linkage), the field's informative censoring, handled by carrying each lost patient's survival from the clinical state recorded at the loss; with another field's nouns the class progression, the class-specific death rates and the migration of the frail elderly do not exist and the task stops reading the same.
layer1: a registry export at visit grain whose NYHA class is written four ways across two EHR eras, with a medical record number crosswalk at the 2024 migration
Florida death certificates matched to the registry by the state's linkage file, and a quarterly neighbouring-state exchange file in its own layout
follow-up end reasons as coded text with a destination state, and a cardiology group's 2023 departure that ended follow-up for its patients
diagnosis dates against first clinic visit dates, and hospital codes that two campuses share before a 2024 split
stakeholder_role: the heart and vascular service line's outcomes epidemiologist, who proposes the 2027 programme hospital to the service line committee

spine.entity: one heart failure clinic visit with the patient's NYHA class

world.geography: United States, Florida (the health system, its hospitals, registry, exchange and people are fictional; counties and states are real geography used descriptively)

driver: The decisive quantity is the share of units still free of an event a fixed time after their start, from a record that loses sight of units once they leave its reach, where units leave far more often after their recorded state has worsened; treating each loss as ordinary censoring credits the departed with the survival of the units still followed, so each departed unit's survival has to be carried from the state it was in when lost, through the moves between states and the state-specific event rates the followed units show.
driver_concrete: Each hospital's two-year survival from heart failure diagnosis for its 2022 and 2023 patients, the patients who moved beyond the registry's death linkage carried from their NYHA class at their last visit through the class changes and class-specific death rates of the patients still followed (equivalently, the followed patients weighted by the inverse of their chance of staying in reach given their class), not Kaplan-Meier with each move as ordinary censoring, which credits the retirement coast's frail movers with the survival of those who stayed.
stump: A competent solver runs Kaplan-Meier for each hospital with follow-up ending at each recorded move beyond the death linkage and names the urban hospital lowest; the step that lands it there is treating those moves as uninformative, when at the retirement-coast hospital they are concentrated among patients whose class had worsened to III or IV, while the movers whose deaths the exchange does report are the healthier ones.

differentiation.task453: task453 v2 reads a measurement change's effect in a rotating panel occasion by occasion against the same occasion before the change; task268 v3 measures nothing that changes: the patients still followed thin out by clinical state as the frail move beyond the death linkage, and each lost patient's survival is carried from the class recorded at the loss
differentiation.task267: task267 inverse-weights a screen's capture rate where the reference test reached members by a known rule at one moment; task268 v3 has no verification design: the losses accrue visit by visit as the frail move beyond the death linkage, and the chance of loss is estimated from the clinical class each visit records
differentiation.task266: task266 counts spells that ended another way as if still open (competing endings); task268 v3's moves are true censoring, informative through the patient's worsening class
differentiation.task263: task263 apportions a level measured only in mixtures of running sources; task268 v3 estimates survival under follow-up that ends by clinical state
differentiation.task459: task459 reads an input-output ratio that bends with the operating level; task268 v3 carries each lost patient's survival from the class recorded at the loss
differentiation.task127: task127 sizes the part of a fused wait an intervention removes; task268 v3 estimates two-year survival under informative censoring
differentiation.task150: task150 projects counts from carry-on rates, steady arrivals and sibling transfers; task268 v3 is a time-to-event estimate whose risk set thins by clinical state
differentiation.task455: task455 resolves identifiers that continue an existing unit under a new number; task268 v3's record-number crosswalk is Layer 1 and its decisive step is the survival estimator

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many people are at each small area on a typical day, known completely only as the members attached to each area and observed day by day only in a broad sample whose on-site rate falls with how far a member lives from the area; carrying the sample's rate for each kind of member onto the complete attachments credits the areas that draw their members from far away with too many present, so the rate has to be carried within the groups it varies across.
lineage.architecture: v1 (a quick-commerce grocer's 2027 weekday dark-store pilot among six metros, by each core's delivery-weighted density of people present, the commuting table's flows carried at a national survey's days on the premises)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-18 at stage 4: the isolated reader carried the survey's share by industry group and HOMEREL onto every flow by reflex and committed the golden call, Tessavon at 28,805 against Corrisford's 21,709 (score_reader.py exit 1); the stratum was a classifier both sources share, so the careful analyst's first group-by; the judge found the call forced, Gate H passing, and two ask forks

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how far each area's stock has fallen, observable either through the records of collectors who choose where to sample by how much they find there or through a fixed probability sample of the whole area; as a stock shrinks it retreats into the best part of its area and the collectors follow it, so their catch per unit of effort holds up while the stock falls and the parts they abandon drop out of their record, and only the fixed sample, weighted over the whole area, shows the fall.
